rss_feeds_articles.headline: When your desperation becomes part of the price
rss_feeds_articles.title: When your desperation becomes part of the price
rss_feeds_articles.excerpt:
Prices once reflected the product and the market. Increasingly, they can also reflect what a company knows — or thinks it knows — about you.

Surveillance pricing uses personal data, behavioral tracking, and algorithms to estimate what a consumer may be willing to pay. If the system can infer that you are in a hurry, financially stressed, or unlikely to walk away, your vulnerability can become part of the calculation.
